environment: local built Worker, local D1, synthetic data
limits: Local Workers only. A real Cloudflare Access application, its identity providers and its published keys are not exercised; the key endpoint is a local stand-in (Miniflare outbound service) serving a locally generated RSA key.

Signature, issuer, audience and expiry checks run the real lib/saha/identity.ts inside the built Worker; the unit-level contract (tests/identity-contract.mjs) covers the same rules with an injected fetch.

Only the Cf-Access-Jwt-Assertion header is honoured; this suite shows the Authorization header and the CF_Authorization cookie are not, which matches the Access model where Access sets the header after sign-in.
Principals whose id starts `fixture:` are the only reserved prefix (open finding L3 of slice 10k); other reserved-looking ids are not refused.

checks.label: setup: the organisation holds real fixture: members created by the demonstration package
control: an ordinary Sites principal signs in (so the refusals below are caused by the id, not the request)
a real fixture member id cannot sign in: workspace, patient list and a command are refused 401 (2 fixture ids)
made-up fixture: ids, the bare prefix and an id ending in the prefix are handled: prefixed ids are refused; an id that merely contains the prefix is an ordinary id
partial or empty identity headers are refused: id without email, email without id, empty id, empty email
on the Sites provider a stray Cf-Access-Jwt-Assertion is not an identity
the refused fixture requests changed nothing: the fixture members still exist and no fixture account was signed in as
B wrangler dev, Access provider: Sites identity headers are ignored (valid-looking id and email, no token) -> 401
B wrangler dev, Access provider: no token, an empty token and anonymous POST /api/commands are refused -> 401
B wrangler dev, Access provider: malformed tokens are refused -> 401 (7 shapes)
B wrangler dev, Access provider: a well-formed token signed with an unknown key is refused -> 401 (the key endpoint is unreachable here, so verification fails closed)
runtime premise: the Workers runtime refuses fetch redirect mode 'error' with a TypeError, and returns a redirect unfollowed (not ok) in mode 'manual'
OPEN FINDING D-1: no Worker-side fetch in lib/saha passes redirect mode 'error' (the runtime refuses it, so the call would throw before sending)
C control: a properly signed token is accepted; the principal is access:<subject> and carries the token's name
C control: a properly signed token also authorises a command (POST /api/commands)
C the key endpoint answers are cached: repeated valid tokens do not refetch the keys on every request
C Miniflare, Access provider: Sites identity headers are ignored (valid-looking id and email, no token) -> 401
C Miniflare, Access provider: no token, an empty token and anonymous POST /api/commands are refused -> 401
C Miniflare, Access provider: malformed tokens are refused -> 401 (7 shapes)
C every wrong token is refused -> 401, with no workspace data (14 cases)
C the token is honoured only in Cf-Access-Jwt-Assertion: Authorization bearer and the CF_Authorization cookie are not identities
C a valid token with Sites headers naming someone else signs in as the token's subject, never as the header identity
C a token whose subject starts fixture: signs in only as access:fixture:<…>, which is no fixture member id
C key rotation: a token with a new key id is accepted after one refresh of the keys
C the key endpoint failing closes the door for unknown keys (503 from the endpoint -> 401) while a cached key still verifies
C refused requests create no account: only the principals that presented a valid token exist
D Access provider without team domain or audience: 503 for valid Sites headers and for a signed token; never a fallback to Sites headers
D Access provider with a team domain outside cloudflareaccess.com: 503 for valid Sites headers and for a signed token; never a fallback to Sites headers
D an unknown provider name: 503 for valid Sites headers and for a signed token; never a fallback to Sites headers
